name: Relevance to Context
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the given context and maintains the flow of the conversation.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is completely irrelevant and 5 is highly relevant

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the extent to which the response encourages further interaction and keeps the conversation interesting.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is unengaging and 5 is highly engaging

name: Naturalness
description: Assesses the naturalness and fluency of the language used in the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is unnatural and 5 is very natural

name: Information Content
description: Measures the amount of relevant and new information provided in the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is no new information and 5 is a lot of new information

name: Empathy and Politeness
description: Evaluates the degree of empathy and politeness in the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is impolite and lacking empathy and 5 is very polite and empathetic
